title: Fix Synthetic First Agent on Ticket Open
description: CreateTicket and ReopenTicket both inject a synthetic TicketAgent with generateHookSessionID() + a fake agent.prompt.submitting event. This results in two agents when only one should exist: the synthetic (wrong) first and the real session second. Remove the synthetic agent from both CreateTicket and ReopenTicket, update tests accordingly.
summary: Removed synthetic TicketAgent creation from both CreateTicket and ReopenTicket. Both functions were injecting a fake agent with generateHookSessionID() and a synthetic agent.prompt.submitting event, causing every new ticket to have a wrong first agent. The prompt/llm/client info is already captured in Interactions[0]. Updated 3 test assertions: TestTicketLifecycle_NoManagement (0 agents after open, 0 after reopen), TestTrackHookInOpenTicketUsesStableSessionIDs (0 agents at open, 1 after first real hook at agents[0]). All 17 TrackHook/Ticket tests pass.
